description: This file defines the GradientAIConfig class, a configuration class for interfacing with the GradientAI API, extending the OpenAILikeChatConfig class. It includes methods for handling API parameters, environment validation, URL construction, and parameter mapping specific to GradientAI.

classes.description: A configuration class for GradientAI, providing parameters and methods for API interaction, environment validation, and parameter mapping tailored to GradientAI's API.
